measured: wall time of compiling the schema test unit(s) once, gcc-16, -Og -fsanitize=address,undefined (gcc-asan flags of test/run.sh), no PCH (cmake_pch.hxx included as text), no ccache; base = unity_schema of bb7f6be (schema.cpp + schema_depth.cpp, one unit, one core); split = the four units of acc235e (branch split-schema: schema_size+depth, read, decode, apart) compiled at the same time on 4 cpus, wall = until the last ends; debug arms -g, -g -fno-var-tracking, -g1
how: 2 rounds; per round the three base arms ran at the same time (3 cpus), then each split arm alone (4 cpus); each compile in its own podman run of localhost/mbedded-cbor-tw (Tumbleweed 20261030, g++ 16.2.1); script measure.sh embedded

context.machine: 4 cpus, Intel Xeon @ 2.80GHz, kernel 6.18.44-fc-v185, KVM, podman as root, user 0, nice 0

script:
set -u
F='-DCBOR_TEST_VECTORS="/src/cbor-test-vectors" -DDOCTEST_COUNTER=__COUNTER__ -DJSONPATH_CTS="/src/test/jsonpath" -DTEST_VECTORS="/src/test-vectors" -D_GLIBCXX_ASSERTIONS -D_LIBCPP_HARDENING_MODE=_LIBCPP_HARDENING_MODE_FAST -I/src/include -Og -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer -std=gnu++26 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wold-style-cast -Werror -freflection -include /b/CMakeFiles/mbedded-cbor-test.dir/cmake_pch.hxx'
c() { # tree debugflags unit
  podman run --rm --network none -v /home/user/mbedded-cbor-build/fast-iteration/$1:/src:ro -v /home/user/mbedded-cbor-build/fast-iteration/cfg-$1:/b -w /b localhost/mbedded-cbor-tw:latest bash -c "g++-16 $F $2 -c CMakeFiles/mbedded-cbor-test.dir/Unity/$3 -o /tmp/o.o" ; }
t() { s=${EPOCHREALTIME/./}; "$@"; r=$?; e=${EPOCHREALTIME/./}; echo "$(((e-s)/1000)) $r"; }
split() { c wt-split "$1" unity_schema_size_cxx.cxx & c wt-split "$1" unity_schema_read_cxx.cxx & c wt-split "$1" unity_schema_decode_cxx.cxx & c wt-split "$1" unity_schema_apart_cxx.cxx & wait; }
for round in 1 2; do
  echo "round $round $(date -u +%T) steal0 $(awk '/^cpu /{print $9}' /proc/stat)"
  (echo "base_g $(t c wt-base -g unity_schema_cxx.cxx)") &
  (echo "base_novt $(t c wt-base '-g -fno-var-tracking' unity_schema_cxx.cxx)") &
  (echo "base_g1 $(t c wt-base -g1 unity_schema_cxx.cxx)") &
  wait
  echo "split_g $(t split -g)"
  echo "split_novt $(t split '-g -fno-var-tracking')"
  echo "split_g1 $(t split -g1)"
  echo "round $round end $(date -u +%T) steal1 $(awk '/^cpu /{print $9}' /proc/stat)"
done
